name: search_failed_requests
title: Sample the requests that failed
description: Explains a problem. Returns the newest requests answered 4xx or 5xx, each with the reason the gateway recorded. errorKey is set when the gateway produced the response itself (for example a rejected credential, a quota, a timeout) and names why; without errorKey the backend answered that status and the gateway passed it through. errorComponent is the policy or connector that failed the request.

environment.description: Id, HRID or name of an environment of your organization. Omit when `api` names an API that exists in only one environment you can read, or when you can read only one.

api.description: Id or exact name of an API. Use the id when several APIs share a name. Omit to search the whole environment.

statusGroup.description: Keep only requests answered with this status class.

errorKey.description: Keep only requests with this exact error key.

window.description: Length of the time range to look at, ending at `until`: a number followed by m, h or d, for example 15m, 2h or 1d. Default 15m. Never an epoch value.

until.description: End of the time range as an ISO-8601 UTC instant, for example 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z. Default: now. Set it to look at a past incident.

limit.description: Number of requests to return. Default 20, at most 50.

total.description: Failed requests in the window; `requests` holds the newest of them.

errorKeys.description: How many of the returned requests carry each error key.
